title: the doctor on an installed box, go-live and key escrow, the backup's audit queue
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's local tests with a stand-in engine and the real psql on the test cluster; no real installed box, no engine daemon

findings.claim: trialbox doctor on an installed box's host read the secrets folder at the containers' path and the box's database at the compose network's address: site_key and key_custody said the folder is not here, flags, provenance_index and the pid-map half of site_key that the database did not answer, on every installed box
findings.fix: this card: the volumes where the engine keeps them, the database through compose exec (box_hold.query)

findings.claim: the doctor's key_ceremony line passed with no KEK yet on an installed box's host without looking: it read the secrets folder at the containers' path, so a TPM box's missing escrow was never seen there
findings.fix: this card: the host's secrets volume; the key_escrow row names the open go-live gate

findings.claim: ComposeOps.audit held a new backup audit event only in memory while it sent the kept ones: a signal partway through (SIGTERM, SIGHUP, the service manager's stop) lost the event
findings.fix: this card: the queue with the new event written whole before any send, under backup-audit.lock

findings.claim: the key ceremony record of a TPM box is still made with no escrow set (key_ceremony._escrow returns None) and the doctor's key_ceremony line passes it; the gate is now at go-live (acceptance key_escrow), not at the record
findings.fix: a ruling: whether the record step refuses a TPM box with no set on a strict box (TB-SOP-03's order)

findings.claim: trialbox provenance is a host command (launch.COMMANDS Need()) that connects to TB_DB_URL, whose host db only the compose network resolves: run on an installed box's host as its page types it, it cannot reach the database
findings.fix: the command runs in the box (as the doctor now asks it, compose exec orchestrator) or in the image on the database network

findings.claim: no expected time is shown before backup, restore or update (10E-15): none of the three records how long a run took, so there is no basis for the line yet
findings.fix: a record of each run's duration per box, then the line before each; with 10E-15's timed runs per tier
